propositions: Coverage percentage and CI-health metrics from GitHub Actions run history must be harvested and persisted to a durable git-tracked snapshot store (.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson) to overcome GitHub Actions' short log-retention window

The GHA adapter (github_actions.py) must parse coverage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run logs and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-green recovery intervals, recheck rates) from run metadata JSON without modifying the test.yml workflow

The harvest_gha.py script must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the gh CLI/Actions API, process them through the adapter, and append labeled snapshots to the tracked store via snapshot.py
The GHA adapter must be isolated and never imported by core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) or the metrics command to maintain portability for future CI adapters

Unit tests must verify coverage extraction (84.2% from fixture log), red-green recovery duration calculation from paired fail-pass runs, correct snapshot persistence to .rebar path (not reports/), and core module import isolation
